Follow the project's Spec-Driven Development workflow. Before proposing or
changing code, read:

- `dbv-specs-ops/project.config.md`
- `dbv-specs-ops/docs/MASTER_PROMPT.md`
- `dbv-specs-ops/docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md`
- `dbv-specs-ops/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `dbv-specs-ops/memory.md`
- `dbv-specs-ops/task.md`

Keep project requirements, architecture, tasks, and memory focused on this
application, not on the framework itself.
